text:
Ruth: new format proposal: 'Community Lightning Labs' 15-20m keynote + three simultaneous 20m lightning tracks (Beginner SDK, Advanced perf tuning, Benchmark post-mortem). shorter demos, more hands-on Q&A. goal = higher intent signal and more trial-ready leads. thoughts?

Sam G: yes. short tracks mean people actually try things during session. main ops ask = how do we manage hands-on support for 3 tracks? need 2 engs per track + 1 floater.

Tara: on messaging, call the tracks out clearly on the signup with expected audience level: Beginner (0-1 day setup), Advanced (quantization, custom kernels), Benchmarks (interpreting curves, cost tradeoffs). this avoids mismatched attendees.

Leo: run-of-show sketch:
- 00:00-02:00 host welcome + goals
- 02:00-20:00 keynote (product outcomes + 2 short customer snippets)
- 20:00-40:00 parallel lightning tracks (attendees choose)
- 40:00-50:00 pooled Q&A + CTAs + next steps
Include a 2-minute transition buffer and pinned fallback videos per track.

Ruth: signup captures: name, role, company, preferred track, experience level (novice/intermediate/advanced), willing-to-share-logs (opt-in). use pref track to route to track-specific follow-up email and SDR specialty.

Sam G: lab materials: for Beginner track provide a one-click Docker + sample app; for Advanced provide prebuilt quantized model and tuning checklist; for Benchmarks provide the dataset + scripts. no real customer data. password-protect any hosted sandboxes.

Tara: rehearsal checklist (short):
- 45m full dress with all track hosts + support rotas
- prep fallback videos (each track 3min)
- test breakout links and handoff messages in platform
- update moderator cue sheet with timing pings
- 1h staging check 1h before

Leo: lead routing: Beginner -> growth SDR, Advanced -> solutions SDR + engineer follow-up, Benchmarks -> product/value SDR. tag opt-in logs to CS bucket for trial tailoring. we'll capture UTM + signup track.

Ruth: measurement: track RSVP -> attendance -> trial opt-in within 14 days. KPI targets: Beginner trial opt-in 12%, Advanced 18%, Benchmarks 8%. also track NPS 0-10 immediately post-event.

Sam G: volunteers for support? I'll take Advanced morning shift, will bring Priya and Dev. we still need 3 for Beginner and 2 for Benchmarks.

Tara: I'll do moderator + copy for signup page. first draft by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Reminder: verify sandbox SSO and that hosted notebooks expire after 24h.

calendar-bot: Event scheduled: "Community Lightning Labs: SDK, Perf, Benchmarks" on 2025-12-02 16:00 UTC. Full-dress rehearsal: 2025-11-30 15:00 UTC.

Ruth: awesome. keep volunteer confirmations here. please add emoji to confirm shift. thanks! :zap:
